skills.name: Steal Heart (摂心)
skills.line: It'll be dangerous for you to keep looking at me.
skills.description: SP Sanbi no Kitsune drains the life of an enemy with her fox force, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Souls Bonded (霊合)
skills.line: May falling flowers be treated well for they, too, have feelings.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the end of her turn, the fox in SP Sanbi no Kitsune's arms unleashes its power, granting her Vulpine Protection, which absorbs damage equal to 90% of her ATK, sustained for 1 turn. Also grants her 3 stacks Heart's Flame stacks. ;Vulpine Protection (霊狐守護) : :'''Buff, Mark''': A undispellable shield that can absorb a certain amount of damage. While it is active, grants her immunity to control effects and effects such as Banish. ;Heart's Flame (心焔) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack increases her DEF by 15%. At the end of an action, and if she not inflicted with any control effects, uses Steal Soul if a non-summoned enemy's HP loses more than 25% in that action and they have at least 10% of their max HP.

upgrades.text: '''Steal Soul''': For each enemy she attacks, increases her move bar by 10%.
'''Vulpine Protection''': When the shield disappears, recovers her HP by 80% of the remaining shield HP.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically gain Vulpine Protection and 3 Heart's Flame stacks at the start battle.

skills.name: Steal Soul (汲魄)
skills.description: SP Sanbi no Kitsune attacks 1 enemy at the cost of 1 Heart's Flame, dealing damage equal to 168% of her ATK. Attacking the same target decreases the damage by 30%. The first 3 strikes on a monster cost no Heart's Flame and have a cooldown of 1 turn.

skills.name: Seductive Phantom (狐惑魅影)
skills.line: Forsake your thoughts and indulge yourself in the realm
skills.description: When SP Sanbi no Kitsune uses a normal attack or deals single-target damage, she also inflicts 20% of HP Steal and inflicts the target with Fox Mark. ;Upon Usage :SP Sanbi no Kitsune attacks 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 105% of her ATK. When attacking, inflicts a follow-up strike for each 25% of HP they have lost. Then she inflicts a strike on another enemy, dealing damage equal to 105% of her ATK. ;Fox Mark (狐印/狐の印) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Max of 1 stack. Removed upon dealing damage. Triggers at the start of turn, deals indirect damage equal to 50% of the inflicted target's lost HP (cannot exceed 1000% of her initial ATK).

upgrades.text: Immediately triggers the selected target's Fox Mark.

bio.condition: Increase SP Sanbi no Kitsune's level to 40.
Increase SP Sanbi no Kitsune's skills 12 times.
With SP Sanbi no Kitsune win 30 times in PVN zones
